scientific_meaning: Outcome is 'not testable' under frozen R2/R3/R4: 278 steps above 2 pp (floor 1000), b_obd on 1 day, F1 below 30 days. The joint-fit coefficient b is a descriptive regression coefficient, conditional on the traction reconstruction, assumed mass 1950 kg and +16 s alignment. The 2 km placebo is nonzero on both sides (9.4 fails) and b swings with the shift, so b says nothing about DEM grade validity.
limits: F2 is fuel-instrumented drives only (disclosed, needed)
unique km is an upper bound
no b_obd, so no attenuation ratio
energy-variant spread and alignment spread must be reported apart, not as one spread
language: b: 'model-derived coefficient, conditional on reconstruction, assumed mass'
R2 = 'not testable'; F3 regen note says 'not computed (R2 not testable)'
F1 single-day intervals: report 'no interval (1 day)'
conditions_before_merge: CV: report the partial 1-SSE_full/SSE_null and dR2=(SSE_null-SSE_full)/SST_heldout, both named; pre-registered null (joint fit without b) stays primary; flat-step-fixed road-load null = labelled post-hoc sensitivity; no ridge; auditor states its definition and reconciles within 0.02 on a narrow re-check (CV only)
F1 primary = all logged-altitude steps (spec has no fuel need), fuel subset secondary; R4 not testable
R2 reasons list support failure AND placebo failure
5 km placebo, if reported, labelled post hoc
follow_ups: rerun only when OBD-altitude days >=30 with fuel
OSM/map-matched design only via new spec
recorded_by: main session from the research-director hand-back (the agent had no Write tool)
